follow-up time: Through delivery and postpartum hospital stay
cohort: 3264 term pregnant women in a tertiary care center, divided into those who underwent induction of labor (n=676) and those with spontaneous labor onset (n=2588).
finding: The study found a 20.71% incidence of labor induction, and while the indications for induction were similar to those in developed countries, the induction group experienced a higher rate of complications, operative interventions, and longer hospital stays.
